_meta.title: Davis-Bacon and Related Acts Weekly Certified Payroll Form
_meta.widget_annotation_kind: /Link (URI to wh347instr) - not a form widget
_meta.FINDING: The official DOL WH-347 (Rev. Jan 2025) is a FLAT PDF. Its /AcroForm dictionary exists but /Fields is an empty array and no page carries a /Widget annotation. pypdf get_fields() returns 0 fields. There is nothing to fill programmatically. Consequence for WageLens: WH-347 output MUST be a generated PDF (own layout, byte-identical field labels and column numbering), not a filled official PDF. See KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md KB-6.
_meta.verification_command: python3 -c "from pypdf import PdfReader; r=PdfReader('wh347.pdf'); print(len(r.get_fields() or {}))"
_meta.field_inventory_source: printed field labels and column numbering read from the extracted text layer of the real PDF, both pages

header_fields.label: SUBMISSION OF FINAL DBRA CERTIFIED PAYROLL FORM
CERTIFIED PAYROLL NO.
header_fields.note: sequential per project per filer, starts at 1

header_fields.label: WAGE DETERMINATION NO.
header_fields.note: e.g. TX20260253 - the field WageLens exists to fill correctly

worker_row_columns.label: WORKER IDENTIFYING NO.
worker_row_columns.rule: LAST FOUR DIGITS of the SSN only. 29 CFR 5.5(a)(3)(ii)(B) forbids full SSN and home address on the weekly transmittal.

worker_row_columns.label: (J) JOURNEYWORKER / (RA) REGISTERED APPRENTICE
worker_row_columns.note: RA requires a matching row in the page-2 apprenticeship block

worker_row_columns.label: LABOR CLASSIFICATION
worker_row_columns.rule: must match a classification listed on the named wage determination, or an approved SF-1444 conformance

worker_row_columns.label: DAYS OF WORK WEEK (top) / DATES (bottom); HOURS WORKED EACH DAY
HOURLY WAGE RATE PAID FOR ST AND OT
TOTAL FRINGE BENEFIT CREDIT
worker_row_columns.note: if non-zero, the page-2 HOURLY CREDIT FOR FRINGE BENEFITS block must be completed for this worker

worker_row_columns.label: PAYMENT IN LIEU OF FRINGE BENEFITS
GROSS AMT EARNED FOR ALL WORK
DEDUCTIONS FOR ALL WORK - TAX WITHHOLDINGS
DEDUCTIONS FOR ALL WORK - OTHER (MUST SPECIFY, SEE INSTRUCTIONS)
DEDUCTIONS FOR ALL WORK - TOTAL DEDUCTIONS
NET PAY TO WORKER FOR ALL WORK

row_total.label: TOTAL HOURLY CREDIT
row_total.rule: must equal column 6B for that worker

fringe_credit_block.trigger: required whenever column (6B) is non-zero for a worker

counts.distinct_named_fields_breakdown: 11 (p1 header) + 19 (p1 worker columns) + 7 (p2 header) + 3 (p2 apprenticeship) + 5 (p2 fringe-plan) + 5 (p2 closing) = 50
counts.populated_cells_note: 1A-3 (7) + hours grid (14) + col 5 (2) + col 6A (2) + 6B,6C,7A,7B (4) + col 8 (4) + col 9 (1) = 34 on page 1, plus up to 11 page-2 fringe cells when 6B is non-zero
